title: Replication Data for: The Geography of Nobel Prize Nomination, 1901-1975
description: Replication package (code and data) for Topaz et al., "The Geography of Nobel Prize Nomination, 1901-1975" (Quantitative Science Studies). Multilayer network of the Nobel Prize selection process, 1901-1975, with permutation, gravity, conditional-logit, representativeness, and flow-asymmetry analyses.
